pair.searchQuery: Early-stage tech founders building AI solutions for in-store luxury retail – personalization, recommendations, or enhanced shopping experiences. Seed stage preferred, US-based.

userContactFile.positioning:
I’m building the future of luxury – one strategic partnership at a time. As the Founder & Principal at Kairos Collective, I specialize in forging impactful collaborations between emerging technology companies and established luxury brands. I see a massive opportunity for innovation within the luxury sector, but it requires a nuanced understanding of brand heritage, consumer expectations, and the power of seamless integration. 

Kairos Collective isn't just about slapping AI onto a handbag; it’s about fundamentally reimagining the luxury experience. We help brands leverage technologies like AI-powered personalization, Web3 authentication, and immersive retail experiences to cultivate deeper customer relationships and unlock new revenue streams. 

We’ve recently secured pilot programs with two prominent California-based luxury hospitality groups to implement AI-driven concierge services, resulting in a 15% increase in guest satisfaction and a 10% boost in upsell revenue. We are also advising a leading sustainable fashion brand on integrating blockchain technology for supply chain transparency and authentication. Currently, I'm actively fundraising for a highly curated accelerator program focused on ‘Tech & Luxury’ – supporting early-stage startups developing solutions specifically for the high-end market. I’m seeking strategic investors who share my vision and understand the unique dynamics of this exciting intersection. I'm also open to conversations with luxury brands actively exploring technological innovation and tech companies seeking access to the luxury consumer market.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking connections and opportunities in the following areas:

• **Investors:** Angel investors and venture capital firms with a focus on early-stage startups, particularly those interested in the intersection of technology and luxury. Seed to Series A funding rounds are of most interest.
• **Luxury Brand Executives:** Heads of Innovation, Digital Transformation, and Marketing at established luxury brands (fashion, hospitality, automotive, etc.). I’m looking to explore potential partnership opportunities and demonstrate the value of integrating innovative technologies.
• **Tech Founders:** Founders of early-stage startups developing solutions specifically for the luxury market (AI, Web3, AR/VR, personalization, supply chain, etc.). I’m scouting for companies to participate in my upcoming accelerator program.
• **Mentors & Advisors:** Experienced entrepreneurs and industry leaders who can provide guidance and support as I scale Kairos Collective and launch the accelerator program.
• **Specific Expertise Needed:** AI/ML specialists with experience in personalization and recommendation engines; Web3 developers with a focus on blockchain authentication and NFT applications; experts in luxury brand strategy and consumer behavior.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• When making introductions, please emphasize my background in both design *and* technology – it’s a key differentiator.
• Focus on the value proposition of Kairos Collective: bridging the gap between tech innovation and luxury brand integrity.
• Avoid framing introductions as simply ‘tech demos’ – emphasize the potential for strategic partnerships and long-term value creation.
• I prefer concise, targeted introductions with a clear ‘ask’ or desired outcome.
• Please include a brief overview of the individual’s background and relevant experience in your introduction.
• I am happy to jump on a quick call to discuss potential connections beforehand.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: Email is best for initial contact. I'm responsive on LinkedIn but prefer to keep those conversations more professional. Quick scheduling links are appreciated.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Please send a calendar invite with a clear agenda. I prefer to be included in meetings proactively if the topic is directly relevant to my work. I am generally available for 30-60 minute meetings.
userContactFile.background:
• **Founder & Principal, Kairos Collective** (2021 – Present)
    – Leading all aspects of partnership development, strategic consulting, and program management for clients in the luxury and technology sectors.
    – Secured and managed pilot programs with leading hospitality and fashion brands, demonstrating quantifiable ROI through technology integration.
    – Developed a proprietary framework for assessing technology-market fit within the luxury landscape.
    – Currently leading fundraising efforts for a ‘Tech & Luxury’ accelerator program.
• **Creative Director & Founder, Atelier Lumière** (2015 – 2021)
    – Established and managed a bespoke textile design studio specializing in high-end fabrics for interior design and fashion.
    – Cultivated strong relationships with luxury retailers and interior designers, resulting in consistent repeat business and national recognition.
    – Oversaw all aspects of design, production, and client management, demonstrating strong entrepreneurial skills.
    – Successfully navigated the challenges of scaling a creative business, including supply chain management and quality control.
• **Education:**
    – **Master of Business Administration (MBA), Stanford Graduate School of Business** (2013 – 2015)
        – Focus: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
    – **Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), Rhode Island School of Design** (2009 – 2013)
        – Major: Textile Design
• **Certifications:**
    – Certified Innovation Strategist (2022)
userContactFile.locationAvailability: I am based in the San Francisco Bay Area and frequently travel throughout California. I am always open to connecting in person and value the richness of face-to-face interactions.
userContactFile.notes:
• Sofia is a *very* strong networker – she’s built a remarkably robust network in both the tech and luxury worlds. 
• She’s incredibly articulate and passionate about her work. Be prepared for a detailed and enthusiastic conversation.
• She mentioned in our last call that she’s particularly interested in companies applying AI to enhance the in-store luxury shopping experience. 
• She’s cautious about over-hyped tech – she prioritizes solutions that deliver tangible value and align with brand identity. 
• Data accuracy check: Double-check the funding status of the accelerator program before making introductions – it’s still in the initial stages.
• Action item: Share the profile of [Investor Name] with Sofia – they have a strong track record of investing in consumer tech.

matchContactFile.positioning: Felix Volkov is the Co-founder and CEO of Aura Hospitality, an AI-driven platform transforming revenue management and guest experience for independent hotels. Having spent over fifteen years in luxury hospitality operations, including serving as General Manager of The Beaumont in London, I identified a critical gap in the market: a lack of sophisticated, yet accessible, technology for boutique properties. Aura Hospitality addresses this by providing a unified platform that leverages machine learning to optimize pricing, personalize guest interactions, and streamline operational workflows. We've achieved significant traction with a cohort of early adopter hotels, demonstrating a 15% average increase in RevPAR and a 20% improvement in guest satisfaction scores. My focus is now on scaling our operations, expanding our product suite, and securing Series A funding to accelerate our growth and empower more independent hotels to thrive in a competitive landscape. I believe technology should *enhance*, not replace, the human touch in hospitality.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
Aura Hospitality is currently preparing for a Series A funding round and I'm actively seeking connections with venture capital firms specializing in hospitality tech and SaaS. I’m prioritizing investors with a demonstrated track record of supporting early-stage companies and a genuine understanding of the challenges and opportunities within the independent hotel sector.

I’m also looking to expand my advisory board with experienced operators and technologists who can provide guidance on product development, scaling operations, and navigating the complexities of the hotel technology landscape. Specifically, I'm interested in:

* **Experienced Hotel General Managers:** Individuals who can offer insights into the day-to-day operational needs of independent hotels.
* **SaaS Growth Experts:** Professionals with a proven ability to scale early-stage SaaS companies.
* **AI/ML Engineers:** Senior engineers with experience building and deploying machine learning models in a commercial setting. 

I am open to discussing potential partnerships with hotel management companies and technology providers that align with our vision.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
* **Hard Requirements:** Introductions to VCs with a demonstrated history of investing in hospitality tech (Series A stage preferred).
* **Soft Preferences:**  Individuals with a strong network within the independent hotel sector. Advisors with experience scaling SaaS businesses. Engineers with a passion for solving real-world problems.
* **Framing for Introductions:** 'Felix is a former hotel GM who built a truly innovative AI platform for independent hotels. He’s solving a big pain point and is seeing fantastic results with early adopters.'  Avoid highlighting the coding aspect unless the recipient is technically inclined.
* **Avoid:** Introductions to firms focused solely on consumer-facing travel apps.  Generalist investors without hospitality experience.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer to communicate via email initially, then happy to hop on a call.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Generally available for calls in the afternoons (GMT).
matchContactFile.background:
* **Aura Hospitality (2021 – Present):** Co-founder & CEO. Led seed round of $2M. Responsible for product vision, fundraising, strategic partnerships, and overall company growth. Currently managing a team of 12 engineers, data scientists, and hospitality specialists.
* **The Beaumont (2017 – 2021):** General Manager. Oversaw all aspects of hotel operations, consistently exceeding revenue and guest satisfaction targets. Implemented new service standards resulting in a 10% increase in repeat guest bookings. Managed a team of 150+ employees.
* **The Savoy (2013 – 2017):** Hotel Manager. Managed multiple departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, and Concierge. Spearheaded a successful initiative to improve guest check-in/check-out efficiency, reducing wait times by 25%.
* **Claridge's Hotel (2008 – 2013):** Assistant Manager, Food & Beverage. Gained extensive experience in high-volume, luxury dining operations. Managed budgets, supervised staff, and ensured exceptional service standards.
* **Education:** MSc in Hospitality Management, École hôtelière de Lausanne (2008). BA (Hons) in Business Administration, University of Warwick (2006).
* **Skills:** Revenue Management, Hotel Operations, Guest Experience, Team Leadership, P&L Management, Strategic Planning, Fundraising, Python, SQL, Data Analysis, Machine Learning (basic understanding), CRM Software (Salesforce, Hubspot), PMS Systems (Opera, Cloudbeds).
matchContactFile.locationAvailability: I am based in London, UK, but am frequently traveling to the US for business. I am comfortable with remote meetings and can accommodate various time zones.
matchContactFile.notes:
* Felix is *very* focused on the operational benefits of Aura. He doesn’t get overly excited about ‘shiny objects’ – he wants to see tangible ROI.
* He’s still very hands-on with the product and occasionally jumps into code. 
* He’s building a strong company culture focused on empathy and customer-centricity.
* Recently closed a pilot program with a small hotel group in Miami – results were very positive. Follow up on this.
* He's a bit wary of overly aggressive sales tactics. Prefers a consultative approach.

qc.judge_reasoning: Person A is looking for early-stage tech founders building AI solutions for in-store luxury retail, while Person B is a founder in the hospitality tech space. While both operate at the intersection of luxury and technology, their specific domains (retail vs. hospitality) and current goals (accelerator scouting vs. Series A fundraising) do not align well enough to create immediate, high-value synergy. Person B is specifically seeking VCs and operational advisors, which does not match Person A's current focus on building an accelerator program.
